newsitem.title: CHINA: China finds 90 mln yuan matured bonds not cashed.
newsitem.headline: China finds 90 mln yuan matured bonds not cashed.

text.p: Central bank authorities have found that about 90 million yuan ($10.1 million) worth of matured treasury bonds held by investors in central China have not been redeemed, the Financial Morning Post said on Tuesday.

Some of the bonds purchased by state firms and government departments in China's central city of Wuhan should have been redeemed more than 10 years ago, the newspaper quoted an official of the Wuhan branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, as saying.
The newspaper attributed the delay in redemptions to people's carelessness about public funds, but gave no further details.
